The main takeaway from our work is that
the Gorenstein projectivity dimension is a better alternative to the classical projective dimension in finitistic dimension theory.

finitistic dimension of an algebra is determined by the Gorenstein projectivity of finitely generated projective modules, and hence finitistic dimension can be computed by G-dimensions of finitely presented projective modules.
